video_title: Hawks vs. Grizzlies Postgame Press Conference: Quin Snyder

quotes.speaker: Quin Snyder
quotes.summary_phrase: Quin Snyder on the importance of collective focus and ball movement
quotes.excerpt: the possessions when we're collectively focused on passing the ball and playing together, we usually get good looks
quotes.quote: Some of what we saw, we've learned before. We just have to have the right focus. The possessions when we're collectively focused on passing the ball and playing together, the results of that, while we don't always score, we usually get good looks. And when we don't do that, it becomes really hard to play defense. The inverse is also true. If we're not locked in mentally on the defensive end and we can't get stops, it becomes harder for us to score.
quotes.social_post: Quin Snyder on the Hawks offensive rhythm: When we are collectively focused on passing the ball and playing together we usually get good looks. When we do not do that it becomes really hard to play defense.

quotes.speaker: Quin Snyder
quotes.summary_phrase: Quin Snyder on Kobe Bufkin's performance after being thrown into the fire
quotes.excerpt: he was kind of thrown in the fire from this morning when we found out CJ wouldn't be able to play
quotes.quote: He was kind of thrown in the fire from this morning when we found out CJ wouldn't be able to play. He competed, saw some really good things. He spaced, not down shot, picked up, played defense, found some people passing the ball when he got an advantage. And then there's other things that a 19-year-old rookie, you expect to see room for growth. I think that's a huge thing for our team, is just having a growth mindset.
quotes.social_post: Quin Snyder praised Kobe Bufkin for his performance after being thrown into the fire on short notice. Snyder highlighted the rookies ability to compete and space the floor while noting there is still room for growth.

quotes.speaker: Quin Snyder
quotes.summary_phrase: Quin Snyder on the need for better communication and defensive focus
quotes.excerpt: there's going to be challenges with rotations and coverages, but there's also things like communication
quotes.quote: Defensively, there's going to be challenges with rotations and coverages, but there's also things like communication. For us, collectively, I think we need to be focused on doing both well because of how intertwined they are. I don't want to give us a pass on either end of the floor. When we give up 49 points in a quarter, really, we have to know who we are. That's collectively defending and running, moving the ball, and scoring collectively as well.
quotes.social_post: Quin Snyder on the Hawks defensive struggles: When we give up 49 points in a quarter really we have to know who we are. That is collectively defending and running moving the ball and scoring collectively as well.

quotes.speaker: Quin Snyder
quotes.summary_phrase: Quin Snyder on Onyeka Okongwu's energy and impact on the glass
quotes.excerpt: you could feel Onyeka on the glass, there was an energy about how he played
quotes.quote: You could feel Onyeka on the glass, there was an energy about how he played, which is something that he's done and given us. More than anything, he just threw himself into the game. His instincts going after the ball and the glass are good. Some make some plays there coming up with some offensive rebounds and putbacks. He's another young guy, every opportunity like this, opportunities for him to get better.
quotes.social_post: Quin Snyder credited Onyeka Okongwu for his energy and impact on the glass. You could feel Onyeka on the glass there was an energy about how he played.
